myapp.ModelBuilding.Behavioural.featureengineering module¶

This module is used for feature engineering.

During feature engineering separate limit from default engineering. For default engineering: The kyc is the first entity set For limit engineering: The loan is the first entity set

myapp.ModelBuilding.Behavioural.featureengineering.add_default_relations_to_entityset(es)[source]¶

Creates relationships between entity sets(default prediction).

Give an entity set create relationships between different data sets in the entity set and add the relationships to the entity sets.

Note

The relatinships used when predicting default is different from the relationships used when predicting loan limits.

Parameters

es (obj) – Feature tools object

Returns

Featuretools object.

Return type

es(obje)

myapp.ModelBuilding.Behavioural.featureengineering.create_default_kyc_entity(df)[source]¶

Create an entity set for kyc

Creates a kyc entitty set used in predicting the default. Initalize an empty called borrowers, decalare all variable types using featuretools then add the resultting entity set to the borrowers entity set declared earlier.

Parameters

df – The Kyc data set.

Returns

An entity set(featuretools object)

Return type

obj

Creates a loans entity set for predicting default.

Given an entity set and a dataframe create loans types and add the data from the df to the entity set provided. :param obj: es an entity set, which is a feature tools object. :param df: a dataframe in this case a loan data set.

myapp.ModelBuilding.Behavioural.featureengineering.create_limit_kyc_entity(es, df)[source]¶

Creates a kyc entity set for limit prediction.

Note

Unlike the create_default_kyc_entity function, this one does not initalize an empty entity set because that is done in the loan entity set.

Given an entity set and a dataframe create borrower types and add the data from the df to the entity set provided. :param obj: es an entity set, which is a feature tools object. :param df: a dataframe in this case a kyc data set.

Returns

An entity set

Return type

es(obj)
